* Made from Durable Wood
* Can be Personalised
* Arrives Ready to Hang

This hanging heart decoration, made from wood and arrives with an included ribbon, is a perfect way to add a personal touch to your Christmas tree.Personalise this decoration with up to 4 lines of text, as below:

1. Line 1 - 20 characters
2. Line 2 - 20 characters
3. Line 3 - 15 characters
4. Year - 4 characters

Please Note: Please note this personalisation is case sensitive and will appear as entered; please refrain from using fixed uppercase on line 3 as this could make the font difficult to read.**How to personalise your product:**

1. Place your order
2. You will receive an email from dunelm@personalisedmemento.co.uk within 1 hour to add your personalised message. If not received, please check your junk folder.
3. Once received, follow the link within the email.
4. Type your message into the fields on screen and click on the preview button to review the personalisation.
5. Once checked and happy, click submit.
6. Production of the order will commence.

**Please note:**

* The content on a personalised product will be produced exactly as you enter it, including spelling and capitalisation. Please ensure that all details, especially the personalised text, are correct before clicking submit.
* Accents, special characters and emojis are not accepted.
* Once the personalisation has been submitted, the order cannot be amended or cancelled. If the personalisation is not submitted within 3 days, the order will be automatically cancelled.
* We do not permit personalisation that infringes copyright laws, is indecent or offensive, or contains language deemed to be abusive, threatening, or defamatory. Full content rules can be viewed on the personalisation terms and conditions page. Orders that do not follow these rules will be refused.

A beautiful personalised glass bauble that features a flickering LED Candle inside perfect for remembering a loved one at Christmas. The bauble comes ready to hang straight on the Christmas tree and will be sure to add some festive sparkle.**How to personalise your product:**

1. Place your order
2. You will receive an email from dunelm@personalisedmemento.co.uk within 1 hour to add your personalised message. If not received, please check your junk folder.
3. Once received, follow the link within the email.
4. Type your message into the fields on screen and click on the preview button to review the personalisation.
5. Once checked and happy, click submit.
6. Production of the order will commence.

**Please note:**

* The content on a personalised product will be produced exactly as you enter it, including spelling and capitalisation. Please ensure that all details, especially the personalised text, are correct before clicking submit.
* Accents, special characters and emojis are not accepted.
* Once the personalisation has been submitted, the order cannot be amended or cancelled.
* If the personalisation is not submitted within 3 days, the order will be automatically cancelled.
* We do not permit personalisation that infringes copyright laws, is indecent or offensive, or contains language deemed to be abusive, threatening, or defamatory. Full content rules can be viewed on the personalisation terms and conditions page. Orders that do not follow these rules will be refused.

By ordering a personalised product, you are agreeing that your details (name and contact details, including address) and the details that you provide of any other party, such as the recipient of the personalised product, can be shared with our third party supplier who provides the personalisation service only for the purposes of completing the personalisation service and delivering the product to you or the recipient.

Command™ Small Wire Hooks are our innovative solution for hanging decorations, calendars and other light weight objects securely and damage free. They hold strongly and remove cleanly using 3M stretch-release technology.For effective damage-free hanging indoors, use Command™ Small Wire Hooks. They’re easy to apply and remove, leaving no holes, marks or sticky residue. Our clear hooks and strips blend in seamlessly making them suitable for any room in the house or office. Rehanging them is as easy as applying a Command™ Clear Refill Strip, so you can take down, move and reuse them again and again.Usage instructions:After attaching to wall wait 1 hour before hanging anything on the hook/strip. Ideal for solid, hollow and painted walls. Do not use on wallpapers, vinyl surfaces or other delicate or weak surfaces. Do not use on windows.

products.sourceDescription:
* Personalised Solar Light
* Festive-Inspired Design
* No Wires & Batteries Required!
* 2 Installation Processes
* Suitable for Outdoor Use

Add some personalised, festive charm to your garden with the Engraved Christmas Outdoor Solar LED Light. Personalise with a surname of up to 15 characters below the fixed text “Christmas at the”. The personalisation will appear in fixed upper case. There are two installation options:

1. Connect the solar lamp base to the ground rod, and push into the ground/pot where you would like it.
2. Drill two holes on the wall, insert the screws and hang up the solar light (screws included).

Peel off the protective film from the solar panel. Press and hold the button for 5 seconds on the bottom of the LED light to turn it on (cover the solar panel with your hand to test if it is on). Please note, the item will not solar charge if it is not turned on. No batteries or wires required, just ensure the solar panel light is placed in a sunny light environment. Short press the button to change the colour mode and light mode. products.sourceDescription:
* Personalised Solar Light
* No Batteries or Wires Required!
* Colour Changing & Multiple Light Modes
* Suitable for Outdoor Use

This Personalised Santa Stop Here Solar LED Light is a cute way to add Christmas spirit to your garden! You can personalise the “Santa Stop Here For” a name below the fixed text. The personalisation will appear in fixed upper case. There are two installation options:

1. Connect the solar lamp base to the ground rod, and push into the ground/pot where you would like it.
2. Drill two holes on the wall, insert the screws and hang up the solar light (screws included).

Peel off the protective film from the solar panel. Press and hold the button for 5 seconds on the bottom of the LED light to turn it on (cover the solar panel with your hand to test if it is on). Please note, the item will not solar charge if it is not turned on. No batteries or wires required, just ensure the solar panel light is placed in a sunny light environment. products.sourceDescription:
* Set of 3 different sizes
* Warm white LED lights
* Choice of gold or silver
* Glitter-finished ribbons and bows
* Individual battery packs with timer function

Add a warm seasonal glow to your home with this Set of 3 Micro LED Light Up Parcels. The set includes 12.5cm (8 LEDs), 16.5cm (10 LEDs) and 20cm (12 LEDs) parcels, each featuring a sturdy iron frame finished with a fabric ribbon and bow in your choice of gold or silver. Warm white LEDs illuminate the glitter-sprayed detailing, adding a subtle sparkle to your festive display. Each parcel is individually battery powered with its own on/off switch and timer, giving you the flexibility to display them together or separately around your home.

products.baseName: LED Light Up Candle Bridge Tower
products.variantName: LED Light Up Candle Bridge Tower · Gold
products.sourceDescription:
* 33 warm white LED lights
* Silver or gold finish
* Durable polyresin design
* 6-hour timer function
* Requires 3 x AA batteries, not included

Bring a warm glow to your festive display with this LED Light Up Candle Bridge Tower. Featuring 33 illuminated pillars arranged in a triangular formation, it makes an eye-catching addition to a mantelpiece or windowsill. The silver or gold finish works beautifully with both modern and traditional interiors, while the concealed battery box keeps the look neat. A handy timer keeps the lights on for 6 hours before automatically switching off for 18 hours, ready to illuminate again at the same time the following day.

products.variantName: LED Light Up Wooden Christmas Scene Candle Bridge · White
products.sourceDescription:
* 7 warm white LED candles
* Detailed illuminated Christmas scene
* White painted wooden finish
* 6-hour timer function
* Requires 2 x AA batteries, not included

Bring a traditional festive glow to your home with this LED Light Up Wooden Christmas Scene Candle Bridge. The white wooden arch features seven artificial candles with dripping wax detailing and flame-shaped LED bulbs for a warm finish. Beneath the arch, an illuminated winter scene depicts churchgoers and trees with a church in the background. Battery operated for flexible placement, the built-in timer illuminates the display for 6 hours before automatically switching off for 18 hours.

products.variantName: LED Light Up Birch Tree · Warm White / 1.2m
products.sourceDescription:
* Choice of three sizes
* 48, 96 or 120 warm white LEDs
* White birch-style branches
* Sturdy base and U-shaped stakes included
* 5m cable with IP44 UK mains plug

Bring a warm seasonal glow to your space with this LED Light Up Birch Tree. The white birch-style branches are illuminated by warm white LEDs, creating a simple yet striking display for Christmas and beyond. Choose from a 1.2m/4ft tree with 48 LEDs, 1.5m/5ft tree with 96 LEDs or a 1.8m/7ft tree with 120 LEDs to suit your space. Complete with a sturdy base and U-shaped stakes, it can be displayed indoors or outside, with a 5m cable allowing the mains plug to be connected indoors.
